scoring_justification: The thermodynamic properties are deterministic functions of density, elastic moduli, and single-crystal constants; the checker recomputes them from the agent's raw elastic_constants.json artifact, then compares to the paper's published values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for isotropic and anisotropic sound velocities, Debye temperature, and minimum thermal conductivity
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper and constitute the reproduction target.

schema.description: Top-level keys: C3, Si3, Ge3. Each value is an object with numeric fields: v_l (m/s), v_t (m/s), v_m (m/s), Theta_D (K).

outputs.description: Isotropic sound velocities and Debye temperature for the three P6₂22 allotropes.

schema.description: Keys: C3, Si3, Ge3. Each value is an object with keys '[001]' and '[100]', each mapping to an object with numeric fields: v_l (m/s), v_t1 (m/s), v_t2 (m/s).

outputs.description: Anisotropic sound velocities along [001] and [100] propagation directions.

schema.description: Keys: C3, Si3, Ge3. Each value is an object with numeric fields: isotropic (W/cm·K), [001] (W/cm·K), [100] (W/cm·K).

outputs.description: Minimum thermal conductivity at 300 K (isotropic and directional).

output_contract.notes: The agent must produce elastic_constants.json (not scored). The checker recomputes thermodynamic quantities from it where possible.

checks.notes: Uses elastic_constants.json from /app/outputs if present; otherwise falls back to comparing agent values to gold.
